description:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager (IC4\) to lead high\-impact network engineering programs that deliver data plane and control plane features and enable new site network designs. This role sits within the physical networking engineering organization and leads complex network engineering projects across Front\-End and Management network layers.  



The successful candidate will own multiple concurrent, business\-critical programs from intake through delivery and closeout.
